input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: changepoint-detector (flagship row 2): known-date bootstrap conditioned on the cut guard, plus page and engine wiring

doc_friction.file: stop hook (commit and push on every turn end)
doc_friction.issue: It fires while a long background simulation is still running, so several tiny WIP commits landed; harmless under a squash merge, but noisy.

deviations.file: ventures/changepoint-detector/README.md (pre-registration habit of the known-date rounds)
deviations.why: The exploratory run showed the conditioned bootstrap has no power under any setting tried, so a pre-registered confirmatory bar would have been set to fail.
deviations.did: Replicated the exploratory script unchanged on fresh seeds (base 45000) to fix the numbers the CLI and page quote, and labelled round 6 exploratory, not pre-registered.
deviations.result: A negative result reported on fresh seeds; nothing ships on the conditioned p.

deviations.file: prompts/goals.md (Write about the work: agent doc)
deviations.why: The README's Round 6 section and the flagship next: field carry everything the next run needs.

notes: Conditional bootstrap (cutConditional) on series the random-walk cut admits, fresh seeds: 306 no-change series flagged 4.9% (round 5's p: 77.5%), 156 real steps flagged 2.6% (round 5: 91.0%); calibrated but blind because the admission event is the evidence. Variants ('sticky' conditioning, walk generator) no better on 25 series per cell. Shipped: knownDate in analyze() and on the page (Playwright smoke: Nile step -289, p 0.002, no page errors), usage event known_date_run, CLI and page warnings with fresh-seed numbers, llms.txt, flagships next. Local checks: known-date*.test.mjs pass; venture suite and preflight results in the PR body.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: a statistician designing, simulating and writing up a selective-inference check plus wiring a test into a web page

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
